status: Source frozen after offline actual-SSR and actual-client focused checks; visual browser and whole-site release validation remain root-owned
limits: This is a directory presentation and labeling review, not a new source review of every linked guide.
No browser, whole-site build, Git, account, tracking or provider changes are authorized in this work.

structure.presentation: Numbered planning stages, topic margins and ruled native link rows; no emoji, shadow cards, raised hover movement or hero image.
structure.fonts: Inherited --font-heading and --font-body tokens; root-selected Playfair Display and Source Sans 3 are owned by shared files.

interface.topicSemantics: Exact membership in a pipe-delimited attribute, falling back to the previous primary topic; search AND-matches normalized words. Empty topics and planning stages are hidden. Reset restores all 44 entries.
interface.schema: One CollectionPage ItemList with 44 names, descriptions and exact hrefs in visible DOM order, sequential positions 1–44.
interface.noJavascript: All 44 native rows and eight topics/four stages visible. Only enhancement form remains hidden; explicit no-JS note and initial count retained.

directoryCopyAudit.scope: Directory labels only; destination bodies were not rewritten or newly certified.
